card.name: Just before aspirin in antiplatelet contexts
card.fires_on: Words and punctuation that come right before 'aspirin' or another antiplatelet drug name, such as 'e.g.,' after antiplatelet agents, 'for' or 'dose' in 'low dose aspirin', and 'pr' in prasugrel.

modes.label: Before 'low dose aspirin'
modes.description: Words leading into 'low dose aspirin' in NSAID or contraindication text.
modes.example: Celecoxib is not a substitute<< for>> low dose aspirin for cardiovascular protection.

modes.description: The 'e.g.,' that introduces a list starting with aspirin and clopidogrel.

modes.label: Inside prasugrel
modes.description: The 'pr' piece of prasugrel in lists of platelet drugs.

card.writes: It seems to push the model to predict aspirin or the next antiplatelet drug name.
card.plain: It fires when the text is about to name aspirin or another blood-thinning platelet drug.
